summary: A toggle for an on/off setting, with its label, description and error beside it, taking part in forms.

label.note: Visible label next to the switch and accessible name. Required: shadow DOM keeps an external <label for> from naming the inner input.

description.note: Help text under the label, in the accessible description.

error.note: Error message. Setting it marks the field invalid and sets a customError validity (SB-0009).

size.note: Track and thumb size. Label text size does not change.

value.note: Submitted with the form while on.

checked.note: Current on/off state. Not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset.

required.note: Native required: must be on to submit. Adds an aria-hidden asterisk after the label.

disabled.note: Native disabled; dimmed; not submitted. A <fieldset disabled> ancestor disables it without changing this attribute.

anatomy.name: field
anatomy.notes: Grid: switch in the first column, label, description and error in the second.

anatomy.name: control
anatomy.notes: The pill-shaped track; holds the native input and the thumb.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.notes: Native <input type="checkbox" role="switch">, covering the track; receives focus, Space and validation.

anatomy.name: thumb
anatomy.notes: Round knob, aria-hidden; slides to the end edge when on (start edge in RTL).

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.notes: Native <label for> in the same shadow root.

anatomy.name: error
anatomy.notes: Persistent polite live region; text appears when invalid.

input.note: Each toggle. Native and composed, so it crosses the shadow boundary.

change.note: Toggle committed. Re-dispatched from the host because native change is not composed (NativeControl). FormData already holds the new value when it fires.

focus-visible.note: 3px solid ring and border in ring color (a translucent ring would fall under 3:1).

checked.note: Track fills with primary and the thumb moves to the end edge, so the state is not shown by color alone.

invalid.trigger: error set, or required and off after blur or a submit attempt

disabled.trigger: disabled attribute or a disabled fieldset ancestor (:host(:disabled))

accessibility.accessibleNameSource: The label prop, through a native <label for> in the same shadow root.

formAssociation.note: FormAssociated + NativeControl mixins. formValue(): value while checked, null while off. formReset(): checked back to the checked attribute. formStateRestore(state): checked = state is not null. validationAnchor(): the inner input (required -> valueMissing, error -> customError). Disabled (own or fieldset) is not submitted. <label for> on the host forwards the click to the inner input.

accessibility.targetSize: Track is 32x20 (sm 24x16); the label next to it is part of the clickable row and the 12px gap satisfies the WCAG 2.5.8 spacing exception.
accessibility.focusRingVisible: On keyboard focus of the input; 3px ring around the track in switch.focus-ring.color.
accessibility.missingNameWarning: Dev-only console warning, once, when label is empty.

keyboard.Tab: move focus to and from the switch
keyboard.Enter: submits the form (implicit submission, SB-0009); does not toggle, like a native checkbox

aria: role=switch on the native checkbox; state exposed as aria-checked true/false by the browser
aria-describedby -> description and error ids (same root)
required: native required; the asterisk is aria-hidden
error: sets a customError validity, so the form blocks submission
announcements: error text is announced once when it appears (persistent aria-live=polite region)

useCases.when: A single on/off setting that takes effect at once, such as a preference
useCases.use: sb-switch with a label naming the setting

useCases.when: The consequence of the setting needs explaining
A dense settings list or table row

antiPatterns.pattern: A switch for a choice that applies only after the form is submitted, or for agreeing to terms
antiPatterns.why: A switch reads as an immediate setting (APG switch pattern); a recorded choice is a checkbox
A switch has two states only

antiPatterns.pattern: A label that changes with the state, such as "On"/"Off"
antiPatterns.why: The state is already announced; the label must name the setting (APG switch pattern)
antiPatterns.alternative: A fixed label that names the setting

drift.contract: label, description and error are props of Switch
drift.realization: shadcn composes Label and Field parts around Switch; shadow DOM requires them inside
shadcn uses bg-input (neutral-200 in light), below 3:1; changed for WCAG 1.4.11

drift.contract: thumb is color.background off and color.primary-foreground on, in every mode
drift.realization: shadcn switches the off thumb to foreground in dark mode; one token per state keeps the pair at 3:1 in both modes
shadcn track is 32x18.4 (sm 24x14); the existing semantic sizes leave a 2px inset around the thumb

drift.contract: built in, with required, error and a form value
drift.realization: shadcn Switch has no label or validation of its own (Radix form bubble input)
not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset

openQuestions.question: Contract content drafted with the contract-author skill (visual reference, WAI-ARIA APG)?
openQuestions.answer: Yes: the visual reference (look, sizes default and sm), APG switch pattern (role, Space, label naming the setting), Checkbox layout for label, description and error.

openQuestions.question: Native <input type=checkbox role=switch> or a custom element with ARIA?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and chosen: native checkbox with role=switch (SB-0007 native first). Validity, required, Space, disabled and form value come from the browser through the shared mixins.

openQuestions.question: Does Enter toggle the switch (APG lists it as optional)?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and chosen: no. Enter submits the form, like Checkbox and Input (SB-0009); Space toggles. Users of form controls expect Enter to submit.

openQuestions.question: Is checked reflected to an attribute?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and chosen: no, as Checkbox. The attribute is the default that form reset restores (native defaultChecked).

openQuestions.question: Is label required, and is there a hide-label option?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and chosen: label is required (the only accessible name, like Checkbox). hide-label is not in this version (not requested; YAGNI); add it the way Checkbox has it when a use appears.

openQuestions.question: Which sizes?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and chosen: default and sm, the two sizes of the visual reference, aliasing the existing size.switch.* semantic tokens; no new semantic tokens.

openQuestions.question: Label before or after the switch?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and chosen: after (switch first, as in the visual reference and Checkbox), mirrored in RTL. A settings row with the label at the start is composed by the consumer later if needed.
